searchText: I'm proposing some specification to how the Long type in GraphQL API is formatted. It entails a breaking change of returning hex-encoded values instead of decimal for some fields. Requesting feedback from the Besu team. https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/389

excerpts.content:
I'm proposing some specification to how the Long type in GraphQL API is formatted. It entails a breaking change of returning hex-encoded values instead of decimal for some fields. Requesting feedback from the Besu team.
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/389
